verdict.rationale: Flagright markets Dynamic Risk Scoring that reassesses risk as behavior changes, and its user API exposes a customer risk assessment (CRA) risk level that can be locked per user. That shows a customer risk-scoring capability exists, but neither configuring risk factors nor explaining score changes is documented. missing for 10: documentation of configurable customer risk factors/weights, a risk-score change history or explainability view showing why a score changed, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
